description: Regione Umbria publishes the geography of completed and tested optical-fibre sections of the Regione Umbria Network (RUN). Four KML resources cover the backbone and sections in Città di Castello, Orvieto and Terni. The dataset title identifies 2014; the later catalogue modification date does not establish a newer network snapshot. These route geometries can help define the physical network extent for telecommunications capacity planning.
